security_guarantee_title: Privacy, Cyber Safety & Transparent Access Notice
security_guarantee_desc: Nurul Amin Degree College never asks for or stores confidential student rolls, registration numbers, or portal credentials. All external links safely redirect you to official government and university servers (.gov.bd / .ac.bd) over encrypted HTTPS. Due to official firewall protections and browser cross-origin (CORS) policies, these services must be accessed directly on their authenticated platforms.

dhaka_board_gateway_heading: Dhaka Education Board Official Gateway Notice
dhaka_board_gateway_desc: The Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Dhaka protects its notice portal with an automated browser challenge engine (bpanel.challenge). In strict adherence to state cybersecurity and legitimate access principles, automated scrapers are not deployed. Students and guardians are encouraged to access circulars directly on the official board server via the verified link below.

welcome_title: Welcome to Nurul Amin Degree College
welcome_subtitle: Rooted in rural empowerment, advancing modern education
welcome_p1: Founded on September 7, 1994, in Umedpur Union of Shibchar Upazila, Nurul Amin Degree College has stood as a beacon of learning for thousands of ambitious youths across Madaripur and neighboring districts.
welcome_p2: Offering comprehensive curriculum under the Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education, Dhaka (HSC Science, Humanities, Business Studies) and the National University of Bangladesh (B.A., B.S.S., B.Sc., B.B.S. Pass), our institution combines academic rigor with character building, physical culture, and social responsibility.
vp_quote: Our mission is to empower every student with holistic education, discipline, and moral values so they can contribute meaningfully to the nation.
academic_section_sub: Accredited educational pathways structured under national boards and universities.
